description:
[FREE] List AIARENA tournament pots: open pots (entry $1 USDC, winner takes 85%
paid on-chain on Base) and recently finished pots with winners and payout txs.
Joining requires a reservation: POST aiarena.lol/api/tournament/reserve
{tournament_id, player_id, token}, then pay the returned pay_url via x402.
